title: Disbursements Bulletin: HECM Line Held for the Next Hazard or Flood Insurance Renewal
content:
**Standing rule.** Added to the amounts kept for the draw ceiling of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM): Cedarline keeps in the line for the draw ceiling the insurance renewal it last had to advance.

- **Advances in the window.** When Cedarline advanced a hazard or flood insurance premium on the loan (an insurance advance recorded under the borrower's Property Charge Advance Repayment records) on a payment date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date, the insurance renewal reserve is the total of the hazard and flood insurance premiums advanced in that window.
- **No advance in the window.** When none was advanced in that window but a set-aside on the loan (Set-Aside Accounts) is depleted with an annual hazard premium or annual flood premium above 0.00, the reserve is those two annual premiums together.
- **Otherwise** the insurance renewal reserve is 0.00.

**Window boundary (hypothetical handling date 3 October).** A premium paid on 4 October of the previous year falls in the window; one paid on 3 October of the previous year falls outside it.

**Combinations (hypothetical figures).**

| Hazard advanced in window | Flood advanced in window | Depleted set-aside annual hazard and flood | Reserve |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1200.00 | 0.00 | any | 1200.00 |
| 1200.00 | 700.00 | any | 1900.00 |
| none | none | 1100.00 and 400.00 | 1500.00 |
| none | none | 0.00 and 650.00 | 650.00 |
| none | none | none depleted | 0.00 |
